pillars.label: Rising pillars
pillars.line: A row of pillars rises across one lane, then sinks. Read the tell; take another lane.
pillars.possessed: pick the lane that rises (Q / E), and when

pendulum.label: Pendulum
pendulum.line: A stone swings across the track. Time it.
pendulum.possessed: hold it at one end, and let it swing

gust.label: Gust gate
gust.line: A blast of wind across the track. Carve into it.
gust.possessed: fire it, and choose its side (Q / E)

sinkhole.label: Sinkhole
sinkhole.line: The sand opens for a moment. Hop or glide over.

gusher.label: Crude gusher
gusher.line: Crude spills across a lane: the board slides on it until it dries. Pop over it, or ride round.

portal.label: Portal pair
portal.line: Two linked eyes. Lit, the first sends you on to the second: a shortcut. Possessed, it sends you back.
portal.possessed: turn it red: while red, the first eye sends a rider back as far as the shortcut would have taken it on (once: a rider sent back is spared until it is past the eye)

turret.label: Wisp turret
turret.line: A Lantern Wisp in a lamp casts its flame at the rider. Parry it, and it flies home and stuns the turret.

antlion.label: Antlion
antlion.line: A maw rises out of the sand behind you and lunges along a lane. Out-run it, carve out of the lane, or hop it.
antlion.possessed: steer it into a lane (Q / E), and lunge

boulder.label: Boulder
boulder.line: A rock rolls down a lane at you. Break it with the shoulder, or hop it.
boulder.possessed: choose the lane (Q / E), and let it roll

hasten.label: Hasten field
hasten.line: A patch where the board's clock drags: whatever is in it slows. Go round, or cross it before it shuts.
hasten.possessed: stop time in it, over the lane you choose (Q / E)

storm.label: Storm cell
storm.line: Marks on the sand, then a bolt on each in turn. Read the marks; the hop does not help, a lane does.
storm.possessed: place the strikes: the lane you choose (Q / E) is where the middle one falls

ward.label: Ward gate
ward.line: A circle on the sand shuts for a beat and the board cannot cross it. Time it, or go round.
ward.possessed: shut it on a rider, over the lane you choose (Q / E)

catapult.label: Pot catapult
catapult.line: Clapperjars lob a pot onto the line. Pop over it in the air, or dodge where it lands.
catapult.possessed: aim the lob into a lane (Q / E)

pendulum.hint: Race 2 haunted races, or wreck 3 rivals with rising pillars

sinkhole.hint: Race 4 haunted races, or wreck 3 rivals with a gust gate

gusher.hint: Race 6 haunted races, or wreck 3 rivals with a pendulum

portal.hint: Race 8 haunted races, or ride a portal on 3 times

turret.hint: Race 10 haunted races, or send a turret's flame back once

antlion.hint: Race 11 haunted races, or wreck 3 rivals with a Wisp turret

boulder.hint: Race 12 haunted races, or wreck 3 rivals with an antlion

hasten.hint: Race 13 haunted races, or break a boulder with the shoulder once

storm.hint: Race 14 haunted races, or wreck 3 rivals with a hasten field

ward.hint: Race 15 haunted races, or wreck 3 rivals with a storm cell

catapult.hint: Race 16 haunted races, or pop 3 pots in the air
